mutations.name: a tiny change reads as 0%
kills: formatShare rounds to one place and keeps a tiny change visible

mutations.name: a size mismatch hides which sizes differ
mutations.find: message={`Sizes differ: main is ${sized(delta.base)}, head is ${sized(delta.head)}, so there is no pixel delta.`}
kills: the Diff tab's delta panel says the sizes differ instead of drawing a delta

mutations.name: the delta caption drops the changed share
kills: the Diff tab's delta panel draws the delta image with the share of the content that changed

mutations.name: an unchanged frame gets a delta panel
kills: the Diff tab's montages gives an unchanged frame and a new one no delta panel

mutations.name: no changed pair gets a delta panel
kills: the Diff tab's montages gives each changed pair a delta panel, with or without a packet diff
